newsitem.title: USA: United Airlines cuts summer/fall fares.
newsitem.headline: United Airlines cuts summer/fall fares.

text.p: United Airlines said Tuesday it is reducing summer/fall airfares up to 45 percent from 21-day advance purchase fares.

The sale begins immedidately and is available through July 11. Domestic travel must be completed between July 14 and November 19; international travel must be completed by December 12, the carrier said in a news release.
United Airlines is a subsidiary of UAL Corp.
Some sample roundtrip fares include: Chicago-Los Angeles, $386; Denver-Seattle, $214; Boston-Chicago, $248; San Francisco-Newark, $438; and Chicago-Honolulu, $699.

The fares are available throughout the U.S., Canada, and selected Pacific markets, including Hong Kong, Singapore, Shanghai and Bangkok. Shuttle by United and most West Coast markets are excluded from the sale, as low fares are already available.
The fares require roundtrip purchase at least 14 days in advance of travel and a Saturday night stay and are nonrefundable. Other restrictions apply.
